name: live-video-chat

scripts.check: npm run build:client && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.db:seed: wrangler d1 execute founderlive --local --file ./seed/sites.sql && wrangler d1 execute founderlive --local --file ./seed/dev-agent.sql

description: Embeddable "talk to a person right now" widget: live presence, one shared queue, private 1:1 browser video calls. Cloudflare Workers + Durable Objects + RealtimeKit.

DB.description: Call history, agents, sites and the inbox (D1). Created for you; the schema is applied on deploy.

MEDIA.description: Your intro clip (R2). Created for you.

LIVE_HOST_ROOM.description: The one Durable Object that runs presence, the queue and the calls.

REALTIMEKIT_APP_ID.description: Cloudflare dashboard → Realtime → RealtimeKit → Create App (in the dashboard, not the API) → copy the App ID. Calls cannot start without it; everything else works, and you can add it later with `wrangler secret put`.

REALTIMEKIT_API_TOKEN.description: dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens → Create Token with the "Realtime → RealtimeKit Admin" permission.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your account id, from the dashboard's overview page. The deploy fills it in itself when it can.
